title: Warehouse skill-will coaching
goal: A shift supervisor can match coaching action to each employee's skill and motivation.

rubric.must: The four coaching actions are visibly labelled in the correct skill-will quadrants.
All four named employees are visibly placed in different coaching quadrants.
Skill and will axes are visibly directional.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the matrix/quadrant exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The drawing visibly matches the source data and case intent: all four coaching actions and all four employees occupy their correct skill-will quadrants, with clear directional axes, quadrant boundaries, and readable labels.

items.evidence: Top-right is labelled “Delegate and develop,” top-left “Coach skills,” bottom-right “Address motivation,” and bottom-left “Direct closely.”
Rina is in the high-skill/high-will quadrant, Mateo in low-skill/high-will, Jordan in high-skill/low-will, and Sam in low-skill/low-will.
Skill is shown increasing from “Low skill” to “High skill” with a right-pointing arrow; will is shown increasing from “Low will” to “High will” with an upward-pointing arrow.
Visible horizontal and vertical midpoint lines clearly divide the matrix into four quadrants.
All employee names and role labels are clearly readable.
